author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Amazon Kiro tries to force AI to work like human, it ends up very tokens inefficient.

I used Goal and told it keep working until the task is done. It created 19 PR a long the way when I am the only one working in the repo.

When I run the same Opus 5.5 in Claude Code, I get exactly one PR at the very end when everything is done.
